title: Understanding Block Distribution
text: Think about how many blocks each machine can potentially store. Since each block is replicated twice and there are $$4$$ machines, how many blocks can each machine hold on average?

title: Calculating Expected Blocks
text: Consider that each block is stored on $$2$$ out of $$4$$ machines. What fraction of the total blocks does each machine store?

title: Fraction of Blocks per Machine
text: If each block is stored on $$2$$ machines, what fraction of the blocks does each machine store?

title: Total Blocks Calculation
text: Now, multiply the fraction of blocks each machine stores by the total number of blocks to find the expected number of blocks per machine.

title: Expected Blocks per Machine
text: What is the expected number of blocks stored on each machine if each machine stores $$\frac{1}{2}$$ of the total blocks?
